title: Defining relative clauses (who / which / that / where)
en:
A relative clause tells us which person, thing or place we mean: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.

who — people · which — things · that — people or things · where — places (where = in / at which).

Don't repeat the subject or object: The man who called me (not who he called me); the book that I bought (not that I bought it).

When who / which / that is the object of the clause, you can leave it out: The film (that) we saw was great. When it is the subject, you can't: The man who lives here…

Use where only when the verb doesn't need an object: the city where I live, but the city that I want to visit (visit + object).
ru: who — люди, which — предметы, that — и то и другое, where — места. Не повторяйте подлежащее или дополнение внутри придаточного. Если who/which/that — дополнение, его можно опустить; если подлежащее — нельзя.

qs.q: A nurse is a person ___ looks after sick people.
qs.exp: A person → who.

qs.q: A fridge is a machine ___ keeps food cold.
qs.exp: A thing → which.

qs.q: A library is a place ___ you can borrow books.
qs.exp: A place + a full clause (you can borrow books) → where.

qs.q: I've lost the keys ___ you gave me.
qs.exp: Things → that / which.

qs.q: Is this the restaurant ___ you had your birthday party?
qs.exp: A place → where.

qs.q: The man ___ lives next door is a pilot.
qs.exp: A person, subject of the clause → who.

qs.q: The film ___ we watched last night was boring.
a: that
which
qs.exp: A thing → that / which (you can also leave it out).

qs.q: Do you know a shop ___ sells cheap phones?
a: that
which
qs.exp: A thing, subject of the clause → that / which.

qs.q: My sister has a friend ___ speaks five languages.
a: who
that
qs.exp: A person → who / that.

qs.q: This is the hotel ___ we stayed last summer.
a: where
qs.exp: A place, “stay” needs no object → where.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The book who I bought is very interesting.”
a: The book that I bought is very interesting.
The book which I bought is very interesting.
The book I bought is very interesting.
qs.exp: A thing → that / which, not who.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She's the teacher which helped me with my exam.”
a: She's the teacher who helped me with my exam.
She is the teacher who helped me with my exam.
She's the teacher that helped me with my exam.
She is the teacher that helped me with my exam.
qs.exp: A person → who / that, not which.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The man who he called me was very polite.”
a: The man who called me was very polite.
The man that called me was very polite.
qs.exp: Don't repeat the subject after who.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “This is the town where I was born in.”
a: This is the town where I was born.
This is the town that I was born in.
This is the town which I was born in.
This is the town I was born in.
qs.exp: “where” already means “in which” — remove “in”.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the woman who works in the bank is my aunt
qs.exp: Noun + who + verb, then the main verb.
qs.ru: Существительное + who + глагол, затем главный глагол.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: this is the app that i use every day
qs.exp: Noun + that + subject + verb.

qs.q: In “The cake that she made was delicious”, we can leave out “that”.
qs.exp: “that” is the object of “made” → it can go.

qs.q: In “The man who lives here is a doctor”, we can leave out “who”.
qs.exp: “who” is the subject of “lives” → it must stay.

qs.q: Which sentence is correct?
opts: The person I talked to was very kind.
The person who I talked was very kind.
The person which I talked to was very kind.
qs.exp: Object pronoun left out; the preposition stays at the end.
qs.ru: Местоимение опущено, предлог остаётся в конце.

qs.q: Paris is the city ___ I want to visit most.
qs.exp: “visit” needs an object → that / which, not where.
qs.ru: После visit нужно дополнение — that, не where.
